extract: Jefferson Scott Shreve is an American politician and businessman who has served as the U.S. representative from Indiana's 6th congressional district since 2025. A member of the Republican Party, he previously served on the Indianapolis City-County Council from 2018 to 2020 and from 2013 to 2016.
